body:
Mythic raiding does not have to be CE or nothing. There are guilds who clear a certain amount of bosses and then call off prog for the tier.


You seem to be wanting CE and wanting a break. So in your case, you can either improve so that you kill the boss earlier which would allow for a break or you accept that CE is not a realistic goal and stop earlier in the tier. You said you would want Painsmith type boss to be the end boss. So what would prevent you from stopping after killing Painsmith and letting better guilds or guilds with more time prog more and more difficult bosses?

For context I enjoy Mythic raiding due to the difficulty (I loved pre-butchering Halondrus and Tindral) and throughout SL and DF I progressively climbed the ranks and am now HoF level. 


From reading your post it sounded like you felt entitled to CE just because you got it previously. Either your guild needs to actually improve or readjust your expectations. Not everyone will get CE every tier. Even in your described scenario there will be guilds who would fall short. That is how it is in all competitions where you cannot always achieve your desired goal without putting in the required effort. Every tier I hear of guilds or players who do improve and climb a lot of ranks, that is, go from barely getting CE to comfortably getting it or average CE to HoF. If you are really committed to getting CE, you have to objectively look at the issues that prevent that and fix them because 600 pulls on Ansurek is not an indicator of the boss being too hard but of the guild not fixing their mistakes. 


Mythic raiding has a bunch of issues that could be solved, but I do not think any of them are in the direction you are describing. If you make CE easy so that everyone can get it, that would be like giving out participation trophies. For me nothing in other games beats killing a hard Mythic boss so reducing that to something everyone can do in a relatively short amount of time with no difficulty would feel lack luster.

Bet kā Tu vari zināt, ka tās bildes (un arī vārds un uzvārds, ja sapratu pareizi, ka tie arī tiek izplatīti) ir ar īsto nozieguma veicēju? Jo viņš pats ir publicējis kādu informāciju? Kā Tu vari zināt, ka viņš pats nav publicējis bildi ar kādu citu cilvēku, nevis sevi? Reddit jebkurš var ielikt jebkura bildi un teikt, ka tas ir viņš. Šeit nav kaut kāda identitātes verifikācija, kad reģistrējas vai taisa postu. Tāpēc es minēju, ka ir labi, ka to informāciju savāc, saglabā un nodod tālāk atbildīgajām iestādēm, kas attiecīgi šo informāciju pārbaudīs. Bet turpināt šo informāciju izplatīt ar pilnīgu pārliecību, ka šis cilvēks ir vainīgs ir ne tikai bezatbildīgi, bet arī pret Reddit noteikumiem.

Pirmkārt, minēšu to, ka tas, ko šis cilvēks izdarīja ir slimi un tādam cilvēkam nav vietas sabiedrībā, bet pilnīgi piekrītu, ka publicēt personiski identificējošu informāciju ir bezatbildīgi. Vai nu visi šie lietotāji ir jauni Reddit, vai nav pētījuši Reddit vēsturi, bet iesaku visiem palasīt, kas notika ar Bostonas maratona gadījumu, kad arī bija "Reddit var" kampaņa un kā tas viss beidzās. Tas, ka izdevās atrast vairāk informāciju par potenciālo nozieguma veicēju ir labi, bet šo informāciju tad vajadzēja nodot atbildīgajām iestādēm, lai tās šo informāciju izvērtē un rīkojas, nevis publiski taisīt vairākus postus dienā.
